github.title: PR review
github.helpInlineComments: Submit formal COMMENT reviews with optional comments on specific changed lines.
github.helpRequestChanges: Allow formal REQUEST_CHANGES reviews for blocking findings. This also enables inline comments.
github.helpApprove: Allows a formal APPROVE review. The App cannot approve its own PR or guarantee CODEOWNERS coverage.
github.helpApprovePublic: Allows a formal APPROVE review. The App cannot approve its own PR or guarantee CODEOWNERS coverage; public PR content is untrusted input.
github.helpStatusCheck: Publish an informational GitHub Check Run for queued, in-progress, and final results. It does not block merging.

github.checksPermissionUnconfirmed: Checks permission could not be confirmed for this installation.

github.readPermissionUnconfirmed: Pull requests read permission could not be confirmed for live PR association.
github.pendingUpgradeChecksKept: This installation has other GitHub App permission updates waiting for approval. Its current Checks write permission remains available.
github.pendingUpgrade: This installation has GitHub App permission updates waiting for approval.

gitlab.title: MR review
gitlab.helpInlineComments: Submit formal COMMENT reviews with optional comments on specific changed lines.
gitlab.helpRequestChanges: Allow formal REQUEST_CHANGES reviews. GitLab records them only while the project bot is a current reviewer — otherwise the finding is recorded as a COMMENT that does not pass.
gitlab.helpApprove: Allow the project bot to record an approval. That is a separate act from a review, and project rules may still refuse it.
gitlab.helpStatusCheck: Post one status note on the merge request for queued, running, and final results. It does not block merging.
gitlab.botMissing: This project is still being set up. Reviews and run notes are posted by the agent's own bot account, so finish connecting the project first.

gitea.title: PR review
gitea.helpInlineComments: Submit formal COMMENT reviews with optional comments on specific changed lines. Gitea takes one comment per line, never a range.
gitea.helpRequestChanges: Allow formal REQUEST_CHANGES reviews. Gitea records them with no further precondition.
gitea.helpApprove: Allow the bot to record an approval in the same review. Gitea refuses one on a pull request the bot opened itself.
gitea.helpStatusCheck: Post one commit status on the pull request's head for queued, running, and final results. It does not block merging unless an operator makes it a required check.
gitea.repositoryMissing: This repository is still being set up. Reviews and commit statuses are written through the organization's Gitea bot, so finish adding the repository first.

slack.name: Slack
slack.label: Follow Slack access
slack.details:
Public channels follow Slack workspace access; private channels, group DMs, guests and Slack Connect users need current membership.
DMs stay private, and agent memory learned earlier is not erased.
Sessions that predate this setting stay hidden until new trusted activity rebinds them to a Slack conversation.
Turning this off hides the sessions synced while it was on — they are not deleted, and turning it back on restores them.
slack.unavailable: Unavailable until console sign-in is configured for this deployment — without it a viewer has no linked Slack identity to check.
slack.unresolved: {count, plural, one {# session hidden — no trusted Slack scope.} other {# sessions hidden — no trusted Slack scope.}}
slack.degraded: Slack scopes stopped resolving — new sessions are being hidden.

github.name: GitHub
github.label: Follow GitHub access
github.details:
Public-repository sessions stay visible to Everyone; private-repository sessions need a linked GitHub profile with current access.
Agent memory learned earlier is not erased.
Sessions that predate this setting stay hidden until new trusted activity rebinds them to a repository.
Turning this off hides the sessions synced while it was on — they are not deleted, and turning it back on restores them.
github.unavailable: Unavailable until console sign-in and GitHub access checks are configured for this deployment — without them a viewer has no linked GitHub profile to check.
github.unresolved: {count, plural, one {# session hidden — no trusted repository scope.} other {# sessions hidden — no trusted repository scope.}}
github.degraded: Repository scopes stopped resolving — new sessions are being hidden.

feishu.name: Feishu/Lark
feishu.label: Follow Feishu/Lark access
feishu.details:
Group sessions created through the matching AgentConnect app follow current chat membership.
DMs stay private, and agent memory learned earlier is not erased.
User-built apps with a different App ID keep the ordinary organization visibility model.
Turning this off hides the sessions synced while it was on — they are not deleted, and turning it back on restores them.
feishu.unavailable: Unavailable until console sign-in is configured for this deployment — without it a viewer has no linked Feishu/Lark profile to check.
feishu.unresolved: {count, plural, one {# session hidden — no trusted chat scope.} other {# sessions hidden — no trusted chat scope.}}
feishu.degraded: Feishu/Lark scopes stopped resolving — new sessions are being hidden.
